words.translation: The pleasant, earthy smell of rain on dry ground
words.sentence1: The sudden summer shower brought out the distinctive petrichor from the parched earth (Die plötzliche Sommerregen brachte den unverwechselbaren Geruch des Regens auf trockenem Boden hervor).
words.sentence2: She stood on the porch, enjoying the soothing petrichor after the long drought (Sie stand auf der Veranda und genoss den beruhigenden Duft der feuchten Erde nach der langen Dürre).

words.translation: The time spent chatting after a meal
words.sentence1: Después de la cena, disfrutamos de una larga sobremesa con café y risas (After dinner, we enjoyed a long conversation over coffee and laughter).
words.sentence2: La sobremesa es una parte esencial de la cultura española para conectar con amigos (The post-meal chat is an essential part of Spanish culture for connecting with friends).

words.translation: Lasting for a very short time
words.sentence1: La beauté d'un coucher de soleil est souvent éphémère (The beauty of a sunset is often ephemeral).
words.sentence2: Il a capturé la joie éphémère de ce moment dans une photographie (He captured the fleeting joy of that moment in a photograph).

words.translation: An ache for distant places; longing for travel
words.sentence1: Das ständige Fernweh treibt ihn dazu, immer neue Länder zu bereisen (The constant wanderlust drives him to travel to new countries).
words.sentence2: Wenn der Herbst kommt, spürt sie ein starkes Fernweh in ihrem Herzen (When autumn comes, she feels a strong longing for distant lands in her heart).

words.sentence1: 森の中で木漏れ日が美しく揺れていた (The sunlight filtering through the trees was swaying beautifully in the forest).
words.sentence2: 木漏れ日を浴びながら散歩をするのが一番の楽しみです (Walking while bathed in sunlight filtering through the trees is my greatest joy).

words.translation: To rest in the shade during the hottest part of the day
words.sentence1: È tradizione meriggiare sotto gli ulivi durante il caldo pomeriggio estivo (It is traditional to rest in the shade under the olive trees during the hot summer afternoon).
words.sentence2: Preferisco meriggiare in giardino quando il sole è troppo forte (I prefer to rest in the shade in the garden when the sun is too strong).

words.translation: Karmic destiny or fate in relationships
words.sentence1: 我们能在这里相遇真是缘分 (It is truly fate that we could meet here).
words.sentence2: 有时候分开也是一种缘分 (Sometimes, separating is also a form of destiny).

words.sentence1: 날씨가 좋아서 공원으로 가벼운 나들이를 다녀왔어요 (The weather was nice, so I went for a light outing to the park).
words.sentence2: 주말에 가족과 함께 가까운 곳으로 나들이를 계획하고 있습니다 (I am planning a short outing to a nearby place with my family this weekend).

words.translation: To be excited, moved, or emotionally stirred
words.sentence1: ខ្ញុំមានអារម្មណ៍រំភើបណាស់នៅពេលដែលឃើញការសម្តែងនោះ (I felt very excited/moved when I saw that performance).
words.sentence2: នាងរំភើបចិត្តរហូតដល់ស្រក់ទឹកភ្នែក (She was so moved that she shed tears).

words.translation: Unique; one of a kind; characteristic
words.sentence1: Sy het 'n eiesoortige manier om probleme op te los (She has a unique way of solving problems).
words.sentence2: Die landskap in die Karoo is werklik eiesoortig (The landscape in the Karoo is truly unique).
